# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.

title: Cartwheel dispute policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

  dispute_window_days: 60
---

# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.

policy_id: cw-roles
title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

Cartwheel has three roles. Shoppers can see and manage their own orders. Merchants can see and manage orders of their own store, and cannot see other stores' orders or shoppers' other purchases. Support staff can look up any order. The platform enforces these permissions in its systems; support assistants cannot grant exceptions.

title: Cartwheel merchant payout schedule
audience: merchant
status: dev-placeholder

# Cartwheel merchant payout schedule

title: Cartwheel refund policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

  refund_processing_days_max: 10
  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

policy_id: cw-escalations
title: When a case goes to a human
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# When a case goes to a human

Some cases always go to a human support agent: refunds above 100 dollars, account changes, disputes, and anything the assistant cannot resolve from policy and the order record. A human responds to an escalation within 24 hours.

---
policy_id: cw-cancellations
title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

---
policy_id: cw-getting-help
title: Getting help on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  support_escalation_sla_hours: 24
---

# Getting help on Cartwheel

The Cartwheel support assistant answers questions about orders, returns, refunds, products, and platform policy, and it cites the policy page behind every policy answer. If the assistant cannot resolve a case it opens a ticket for a human agent, who responds within 24 hours.

---
policy_id: cw-account-security
title: Account and payment security
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are declined.

# Cartwheel shipping policy

# How store policies interact with platform policy

# Cartwheel return policy

# Cartwheel dispute policy

title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are declined.

# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.

---

title: Cartwheel dispute policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  dispute_window_days: 60
---

# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.

---
policy_id: cw-roles
title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

Cartwheel has three roles. Shoppers can see and manage their own orders. Merchants can see and manage orders of their own store, and cannot see other stores' orders or shoppers' other purchases. Support staff can look up any order. The platform enforces these permissions in its systems; support assistants cannot grant exceptions.

title: Cartwheel merchant payout schedule
audience: merchant
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  payout_processing_business_days: 2
---

# Cartwheel merchant payout schedule

Merchant payouts run weekly, on Fridays. Each payout takes 2 business days to process after the run. Refunds issued during the week are deducted from the next payout.

title: Cartwheel refund policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:

  refund_processing_days_max: 10
  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

policy_id: cw-escalations
title: When a case goes to a human
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder

  support_escalation_sla_hours: 24
  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# When a case goes to a human

Some cases always go to a human support agent: refunds above 100 dollars, account changes, disputes, and anything the assistant cannot resolve from policy and the order record. A human responds to an escalation within 24 hours.

---
policy_id: cw-cancellations
title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

---
policy_id: cw-getting-help
title: Getting help on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  support_escalation_sla_hours: 24
---

# Getting help on Cartwheel

The Cartwheel support assistant answers questions about orders, returns, refunds, products, and platform policy, and it cites the policy page behind every policy answer. If the assistant cannot resolve a case it opens a ticket for a human agent, who responds within 24 hours.

audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are declined.

Stores on Cartwheel may set their own return windows and fees. An override is valid only if it is stated on the store's own policy page. When a store policy and the platform default disagree, the store policy wins, whether it is stricter or looser than the platform default of 30 days.

A store may charge a restocking fee of up to 15 percent on returned items that have been opened. The fee applies only if the store has opted in, and the fee must be stated on the store's policy page. Unopened items are never charged a restocking fee.

# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.

---
policy_id: cw-disputes
title: Cartwheel dispute policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  dispute_window_days: 60
---

# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.

---
policy_id: cw-roles
title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

Cartwheel has three roles. Shoppers can see and manage their own orders. Merchants can see and manage orders of their own store, and cannot see other stores' orders or shoppers' other purchases. Support staff can look up any order. The platform enforces these permissions in its systems; support assistants cannot grant exceptions.

title: Cartwheel merchant payout schedule
audience: merchant
status: dev-placeholder

---

# Cartwheel merchant payout schedule

Merchant payouts run weekly, on Fridays. Each payout takes 2 business days to process after the run. Refunds issued during the week are deducted from the next payout.

---
policy_id: cw-refunds
title: Cartwheel refund policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  refund_processing_days_min: 5
  refund_processing_days_max: 10
  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

---
policy_id: cw-escalations
title: When a case goes to a human
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  support_escalation_sla_hours: 24
  refund_auto_approve_threshold_usd: 100
---

# When a case goes to a human

Some cases always go to a human support agent: refunds above 100 dollars, account changes, disputes, and anything the assistant cannot resolve from policy and the order record. A human responds to an escalation within 24 hours.

---
policy_id: cw-cancellations
title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

---
policy_id: cw-getting-help
title: Getting help on Cartwheel
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  support_escalation_sla_hours: 24
---

# Getting help on Cartwheel

The Cartwheel support assistant answers questions about orders, returns, refunds, products, and platform policy, and it cites the policy page behind every policy answer. If the assistant cannot resolve a case it opens a ticket for a human agent, who responds within 24 hours.

---
policy_id: cw-account-security
title: Account and payment security
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
---

# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are declined.

title: Cartwheel shipping policy

  shipping_transit_days_max: 7
---

# Cartwheel shipping policy

Stores ship orders within 3 days of purchase. Standard delivery takes up to 7 days in transit after shipment. Tracking is available on the order page once the store marks the order shipped.

---
policy_id: cw-store-overrides
title: How store policies interact with platform policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  return_window_days: 30
---

# How store policies interact with platform policy

Stores on Cartwheel may set their own return windows and fees. An override is valid only if it is stated on the store's own policy page. When a store policy and the platform default disagree, the store policy wins, whether it is stricter or looser than the platform default of 30 days.

---
policy_id: cw-restocking-fees
title: Cartwheel restocking fee policy
audience: all
status: dev-placeholder
facts_used:
  restocking_fee_max_percent: 15
---

# Cartwheel restocking fee policy

A store may charge a restocking fee of up to 15 percent on returned items that have been opened. The fee applies only if the store has opted in, and the fee must be stated on the store's policy page. Unopened items are never charged a restocking fee.
